items.title: Apple (AAPL) Challenges Secret UK Order For An iPhone Backdoor
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is contesting a covert UK government order that would require an encryption backdoor for iPhones. The company has filed a legal challenge seeking public acknowledgment of the directive and an end to related gagging rules. Apple argues that weakening iPhone encryption for UK authorities could affect device security standards for users globally. items.title: Should You Buy HP Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?
items.summary: HP (HPQ) stock has run hard over the past six months, gaining about 78%, and it still trades roughly 8% below its 52-week high. The steadier story is the share count. HP retires a slice of its own stock every year, so earnings per share grow faster than profits do. The question is whether a rising memory bill breaks that.
